title: Bridging the Terminology Gap: A Data-Centric Alignment Framework for Multilingual Translation in Cross-Border Corporation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19858v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As globalization accelerates the demand for seamless cross-border enterprise collaboration, multilingual translation remains bottlenecked by insufficient domain-specific terminology, rigid terminology translation, weak instruction-following capabilities, and high inference latency in long-instruction scenarios. To overcome these barriers, we propose Bridging the Terminology Gap (BTG), a data-centric framework. First, BTG mines cross-lingual term alignments from domain documents and leverages LLMs to synthesize terminology-rich parallel corpora. Second, a hybrid filtering strategy combining heuristics and XCOMET scoring ensures high data fidelity. Third, a two-stage training paradigm employs supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for targeted terminology injection, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) to refine output preferences, effectively balancing domain knowledge integration with model reliability. tldr: 该论文提出以数据为中心的BTG框架，通过挖掘跨语言术语对齐并利用LLM合成术语丰富的平行语料，结合混合过滤策略与SFT加RL的两阶段训练，有效提升跨国企业场景下多语言翻译的术语准确性与模型可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BTG, a data-centric framework that mines cross-lingual term alignments from domain documents, synthesizes terminology-rich parallel corpora with LLMs, and employs a two-stage SFT-then-RL training paradigm to enhance terminology accuracy and reliability in multilingual translation for cross-border corporations.
